answer: Make every identity keep a pulse: each epoch it must answer a fresh, seeded prompt, and peers grade the text before any reward unlocks. A sybil farm is like a wharf crowded with empty boats; mooring is cheap, but each hull still has to be rowed every single day. Rewards vest slowly, terrace by terrace, so an account that skips epochs or turns in near-duplicates loses its unvested share. Running a thousand fakes then costs a thousand honest workloads.
